title: MaD-RSI: Model-as-Data for Recursive Self-Improvement of Agent Harnesses
title_zh: MaD-RSI：面向智能体框架递归自我改进的“模型即数据”方法

paragraphs.en: Recursive self-improvement (RSI) of agent harnesses has emerged as an effective approach to enhancing the capabilities of large language model (LLM) agents. By searching the harness space for a specific LLM on a given dataset, RSI can discover a harness tailored to the capabilities and behavioral characteristics of that model. However, such optimization often creates a strong coupling between the learned harness and its target LLM, limiting generalization across models and requiring substantial computational resources to adapt to new LLMs. Moreover, existing RSI methods typically optimize a harness using feedback from a single model and evaluate its generalization to other models only after training. This paradigm treats model differences primarily as a criterion for evaluating generalization rather than as valuable evidence for optimization. In this paper, we introduce a new perspective that treats models as data and places the harness at the center of optimization. Building on this perspective, we propose MaD-RSI , a framework that directly optimizes a shared harness across multiple heterogeneous LLMs by incorporating their diverse failure trajectories into the training process. Rather than assessing model differences only after optimization, MaD-RSI leverages these differences as training evidence to guide the self-improvement of a shared harness. Furthermore, we introduce a new evaluation framework with two complementary metrics designed to assess the effectiveness of harness optimization across models. Experiments across multiple datasets and LLMs demonstrate that MaD-RSI improves generalization over existing approaches while reducing training costs.

paragraphs.en: Large language model (LLM) agents have achieved strong performance on complex tasks, including reasoning and code generation ( Yang et al., 2024 ; Yao et al., 2023 ; Chen et al., 2025 ) . Their effectiveness depends not only on the underlying LLM but also on the harness. Recent work on recursive self-improvement (RSI) has shown that iteratively searching and refining this harness can enhance agent capabilities without updating model parameters ( Chan et al., 2026 ; Duan et al., 2026 ; Lin et al., 2026 ) . However, many RSI methods optimize a harness using execution feedback from a single target LLM ( Liu et al., 2026 ) . Such specialization can entangle the learned harness with the capabilities and behavioral characteristics of that model, limiting its portability to other LLMs ( Qu et al., 2026 ) . Adapting the harness to a new model may therefore require another costly optimization run, making it difficult to build an ecosystem of reusable and continuously improving harnesses.
paragraphs.zh: 大语言模型（LLM）智能体在复杂任务上取得了出色的表现，包括推理和代码生成（Yang et al., 2024; Yao et al., 2023; Chen et al., 2025）。 它们的有效性不仅取决于底层的大语言模型，还取决于 harness。 最近关于递归自我改进（RSI）的研究表明，迭代地搜索和改进这种 harness 可以在不更新模型参数的情况下提升智能体的能力（Chan et al., 2026; Duan et al., 2026; Lin et al., 2026）。 然而，许多 RSI 方法仅使用来自单个目标大语言模型的执行反馈来优化 harness（Liu et al., 2026）。 这种特化可能使学习到的 harness 与该模型的能力和行为特性纠缠在一起，限制了它向其他大语言模型的可移植性（Qu et al., 2026）。 因此，将 harness 适配到新模型可能需要另一次代价高昂的优化运行，这使得构建一个可复用且持续改进的 harness 生态系统变得困难。

paragraphs.en: This limitation also shapes how RSI is evaluated. A common protocol optimizes a harness with one LLM and assesses its transfer to other models ( Lee et al., 2026 ; Xia et al., 2026 ) . In this paradigm, differences among models primarily serve to measure generalization, rather than to guide improvement. Yet heterogeneous LLMs can exhibit different outcomes and execution trajectories on the same task under the same harness. A failure from one model, when contrasted with a success from another, may reveal deficiencies that are difficult to identify from either trajectory alone. These observations suggest a different question: Can behavioral differences among LLMs serve as training evidence for learning a harness that generalizes across models?
paragraphs.zh: 这一局限性也影响了 RSI 的评估方式。 一种常见的评估方案是用一个大语言模型优化一个执行框架，然后评估其向其他模型的迁移能力（Lee et al., 2026；Xia et al., 2026）。 在这一范式下，模型之间的差异主要用于衡量泛化能力，而非指导改进。 然而，异构的大语言模型在同一执行框架下执行同一任务时，可能表现出不同的结果和执行轨迹。 将一个模型的失败与另一个模型的成功进行对比，可能揭示出仅从单一轨迹难以发现的缺陷。 这些观察引出了一个不同的问题：大语言模型之间的行为差异能否作为训练证据，用于学习一个可跨模型泛化的执行框架？

sents.zh: 这一局限性也影响了 RSI 的评估方式。

sents.zh: 将一个模型的失败与另一个模型的成功进行对比，可能揭示出仅从单一轨迹难以发现的缺陷。

sents.en: These observations suggest a different question: Can behavioral differences among LLMs serve as training evidence for learning a harness that generalizes across models?
sents.zh: 这些观察引出了一个不同的问题：大语言模型之间的行为差异能否作为训练证据，用于学习一个可跨模型泛化的执行框架？

paragraphs.en: We address this question through Models-as-Data , a perspective that treats heterogeneous LLMs, observed under controlled inference configurations ( DeepSeek-AI, 2026 ) (such as sampling), as sources of behavioral evidence while placing the shared harness at the center of optimization ( Mehri et al., 2022 ) . Instead of viewing models solely as separate optimization targets or subjects of subsequent transfer evaluation, we use their successful and failed executions as complementary signals for harness improvement. The goal is to optimize a single harness that can be used with different LLMs independently, not to ensemble multiple models at inference time.
paragraphs.zh: 我们通过“模型即数据”（Models-as-Data）的视角来回答这一问题，该视角将异构的大语言模型视为行为证据的来源——在受控的推理配置（DeepSeek-AI, 2026）（例如采样）下对其进行观察——同时将共享的测试框架置于优化的核心位置（Mehri et al., 2022）。 我们不再仅仅将各个模型视为独立的优化目标或后续迁移评估的对象，而是把它们的成功执行与失败执行作为改进测试框架的互补信号。 目标是优化出一个可以独立搭配不同大语言模型使用的单一测试框架，而不是在推理时对多个模型进行集成。

sents.zh: 我们不再仅仅将各个模型视为独立的优化目标或后续迁移评估的对象，而是把它们的成功执行与失败执行作为改进测试框架的互补信号。

sents.en: The goal is to optimize a single harness that can be used with different LLMs independently, not to ensemble multiple models at inference time.
sents.zh: 目标是优化出一个可以独立搭配不同大语言模型使用的单一测试框架，而不是在推理时对多个模型进行集成。

paragraphs.en: Building on this perspective, we propose MaD-RSI , a framework for RSI of a shared harness using evidence from multiple heterogeneous LLMs. MaD-RSI first organizes responses to shared queries across models and inference configurations into a structured tensor, preserving the conditions under which each outcome is observed. It then selects informative queries using both disagreement among models and coverage of distinct response patterns. Finally, it jointly diagnoses aligned successful and failed trajectories to inform subsequent harness revisions. In this way, behavioral differences across models become inputs to the optimization process rather than observations reserved for evaluation.
paragraphs.zh: 基于这一视角，我们提出了 MaD-RSI，一个利用来自多个异构大语言模型（LLM）的证据对共享测试框架进行 RSI 的框架。 MaD-RSI 首先将各模型及不同推理配置对共享查询的响应组织成一个结构化张量，保留观察到每个结果时的条件信息。 然后，它综合模型间的分歧程度以及不同响应模式的覆盖情况来选择信息量大的查询。 最后，它联合诊断对齐的成功轨迹与失败轨迹，为后续的测试框架修订提供依据。 通过这种方式，模型之间的行为差异成为优化过程的输入，而不是仅用于评估的观察对象。

sents.zh: 然后，它综合模型间的分歧程度以及不同响应模式的覆盖情况来选择信息量大的查询。

paragraphs.en: To assess RSI methods designed for multiple models, we further introduce an evaluation framework with two complementary measures of optimization effectiveness: success coverage , which captures whether at least one model succeeds on a task, and joint success , which captures whether all evaluated models succeed on that task. These population measures complement evaluations of transfer to previously unseen LLMs. We study MaD-RSI on legal reasoning, code generation, medical reasoning, and agent safety tasks across heterogeneous LLMs. The results show improvements in performance across models and transfer in some settings, with tradeoffs that vary by task. On the general tasks, optimizing one shared harness also reduces cumulative training cost relative to running separate optimization processes for each development model. More broadly, this study invites a reconsideration of the role of LLMs in RSI: beyond being targets of harness optimization, they can provide the evidence that drives it. We summarize our contributions as follows:
paragraphs.zh: 为了评估为多模型设计的 RSI 方法，我们进一步引入了一个评估框架，其中包含两个互补的优化效果度量：成功覆盖，衡量是否至少有一个模型在某任务上成功；以及联合成功，衡量所有被评估的模型是否都在该任务上成功。 这些总体性度量与对迁移到先前未见过的 LLM 的评估互为补充。 我们在法律推理、代码生成、医疗推理和智能体安全任务上，跨异构 LLM 研究了 MaD-RSI。 结果表明，各模型的性能均有提升，并且在某些设置下实现了迁移，同时存在因任务而异的权衡。 在通用任务上，优化一个共享的框架相比于为每个开发模型分别运行独立的优化流程，还能降低累计训练成本。 更广泛地说，本研究促使我们重新思考 LLM 在 RSI 中的角色：它们不仅是框架优化的目标，还可以提供驱动优化的证据。 我们将本文的贡献总结如下：

paragraphs.en: Here p ¯ q ​ s = ∑ m w m ​ p q ​ m ​ s \bar{p}_{qs}=\sum_{m}w_{m}p_{qms} and h h is binary entropy ( Fang et al., 2025 ) . The score captures differences in empirical success rates across models under matched sampling conditions. Equal rates across models at every setting yield zero disagreement, even when individual executions vary. Computing disagreement before averaging across configurations preserves contrasts that pooling observations could hide. For binary tasks, we first reserve anchor queries, including unanimous successes and failures when available. These unanimous outcomes remain available for diagnosis despite their zero disagreement. We fill the remaining query budget for diagnosis by repeatedly adding the query with the largest combined gain in disagreement and response-pattern coverage. The coverage term favors queries that represent response patterns poorly covered by the selected set ( Agarwal et al., 2025 ) . These patterns span models and sampling configurations. For categorical outcomes, we use the corresponding entropy contrast and a separate ranking rule. The tensor guides query selection, while trajectories supply evidence for diagnosis. For each selected query, MaD-RSI assembles this evidence within an input budget, preserving outcome labels and source identities. Joint diagnosis compares shared failures, model-specific failures, and successful executions. Each diagnostic claim must cite source evidence identifiers. Successful traces provide contrasts for assessing proposed edits. Disagreement alone does not establish a failure cause or a useful fix. An LLM then uses the joint diagnoses to propose revisions to the shared harness.

paragraphs.en: We further examine computational costs against the aggregate expenditure of four independently optimized baselines (see Figure 2 ). Baseline (MAX) and Baseline (AVG) represent the per-metric maximum and mean across these baselines, respectively. Both are computed from the same training and evaluation runs and therefore share identical costs. Importantly, the reported maxima may originate from different harnesses and do not necessarily correspond to a single configuration. The efficiency advantage therefore lies in jointly optimizing a shared harness for multiple models, rather than optimizing for a single model. Across all four datasets, MaD-RSI also requires fewer inference tokens and time than the four baselines combined.

paragraphs.en: Existing methods for RSI of agent harnesses largely follow a common paradigm: optimizing a harness using a single execution model and subsequently evaluating its transfer across models ( Hu et al., 2025 ; Zhang et al., 2026 ; Lee et al., 2026 ; Xia et al., 2026 ) . However, improvements achieved during optimization do not necessarily transfer to other models. Previous empirical findings suggest that harness modifications tailored to the failure modes of a source model may provide limited benefits to other models or even degrade their performance ( Qu et al., 2026 ; Wang et al., 2026 ; Rakotonirina et al., 2023 ) . This observation motivates us to incorporate behavioral differences across models directly into the training evidence. Unlike existing approaches, MaD-RSI compares the behaviors of different frozen execution models during evidence construction. Specifically, it aligns responses to the same query across models and sampling configurations, leverages these aligned observations for query selection and joint diagnosis, and uses the resulting evidence to guide the optimization of a shared harness.
paragraphs.zh: 现有的智能体支架 RSI 方法大多遵循一个共同的范式：使用单一执行模型优化支架，随后评估其在其他模型上的迁移效果（Hu et al., 2025; Zhang et al., 2026; Lee et al., 2026; Xia et al., 2026）。 然而，优化过程中取得的提升并不一定能迁移到其他模型。 先前的实证研究结果表明，针对源模型失败模式定制的支架修改可能对其他模型收益有限，甚至会降低其性能（Qu et al., 2026; Wang et al., 2026; Rakotonirina et al., 2023）。 这一观察促使我们将不同模型之间的行为差异直接纳入训练证据之中。 与现有方法不同，MaD-RSI 在证据构建过程中比较不同的冻结执行模型的行为。 具体而言，它对齐不同模型与不同采样配置下对同一查询的响应，利用这些对齐的观察结果进行查询选择和联合诊断，并使用由此得到的证据来指导共享支架的优化。

paragraphs.en: In this paper, we introduce Models-as-Data , a new perspective that treats heterogeneous LLMs as behavioral data sources for shared harness optimization. Building on this perspective, we propose MaD-RSI , which leverages behavioral differences across models to guide RSI. We further introduce two complementary metrics to evaluate optimization effectiveness across models. Experiments across diverse tasks and LLMs demonstrate improved generalization in several settings and reduced cumulative training costs compared with independent optimization on general tasks. We hope this work encourages a broader shift in RSI from optimizing harnesses for individual models toward learning reusable harnesses from diverse model behaviors.
paragraphs.zh: 本文提出 Models-as-Data（模型即数据）这一新视角，将异构大语言模型视为共享评测框架优化的行为数据源。 基于这一视角，我们提出 MaD-RSI，利用不同模型之间的行为差异来指导 RSI。 我们进一步引入两个互补的指标，用于评估跨模型优化的有效性。 在多种任务和大语言模型上的实验表明，与在通用任务上独立优化相比，该方法在若干设置下提升了泛化能力，并降低了累积训练成本。 我们希望这项工作能推动 RSI 发生更广泛的转变：从为单个模型优化评测框架，转向从多样的模型行为中学习可复用的评测框架。
